74ff9b7d4d71: English uses one verb (go) for both; Polish splits them: iść / chodzić, jechać / jeździć. Ask two students to say one sentence about «now» and one about «always».
01a6e8c4c490: Like English go → went: a different stem. Oni szli (male persons), one szły (women, children, buses) — revision from lesson 3.
af35782da1c0: Plan na jutro: idę, jadę — jak angielskie «I'm going tomorrow».
cb4cf56f507b: English uses one verb for both (“fly”, “run”, “carry”, “drive”); Polish has a pair for each. Lecieć: lecę, lecisz. Wieźć: wiozę, wieziesz. Nosić: noszę.
0e6a9fd52e6d: It's about the fact that I'll be late.
03ac6ead81b4: The „right now / regularly” rule does not work here — these are fixed expressions. Chodzi o… = it's about…; jak ci idzie? = how are you getting on with…? Ask everyone to ask their neighbour «Jak ci idzie…?».
22da09143130: Like English go → go out, come → come in. Link to lesson 6: a prefix makes the verb perfective. Write -jść without «i»: wyjść, przyjść.
e480977f8b5c: English uses particles instead: go in, go out, come, step away, cross over, reach. W- before a vowel becomes we-: wejść (English «to go in»).
8243fa049172: Z- = down: zejść ze schodów. Za- = to drop in on the way: zajść do sklepu. Ob- = to go round, to drive round. Roz- = to go separate ways.
4622bf663b3f: Dokąd from lesson 1 (nad morze). From a person — od: wracam od babci, od lekarza. Before some words — ze: ze szkoły, ze sklepu.
8f5ee54525ae: I go by bus or by tram.
75cf852d5720: Narzędnik (instrumental) — from lesson 1. Both forms with a bicycle are correct; likewise na hulajnodze / hulajnogą. Samolotem — lecę, not jadę.
7467a895e312: Pójść — with ó, not «poiść». Wszedł, but weszła, weszli. Write on the board the forms students pronounce wrongly.
b2e0310d80a0: yesterday I went to the cinema
824fc9a0878c: The first three are the grammar of motion. Poles will understand «Chodziłem do kina» as «I went regularly». A one-off trip is byłem / poszedłem.
dde3f28fce65: The second set of three are lexical calques. «Kompostować bilet» always makes the group laugh — a good moment to fix skasować in their memory.
